extracted.intended_audience: researchers, historians, patent attorneys, and archivists interested in 1878 U.S. design patents and registered trademarks
extracted.subtask_description: An alphabetical index listing patentees of designs and registered trade-marks for the year 1878, including patentee names, residences, design titles, patent numbers, Official Gazette references, and registration dates. Useful as a historical catalogue or bibliographic/dataset source for patent research.
